xenophile.definition: person attracted to foreign people or cultures
xenophile.ex: As a xenophile, she loved exploring foreign customs.
xenophile.mnemonic: xeno-phile – videshi cheezein pasand karne wala fan

xenophobia.definition: intense fear or dislike of foreigners
xenophobia.ex: Rising xenophobia made immigrants feel unwelcome in the town.
xenophobia.mnemonic: xenophobia – Xen naam ke foreigner se phobia lagta hai

xenophobe.definition: person who fears or hates foreigners
xenophobe.ex: The xenophobe distrusted anyone from another country.
xenophobe.mnemonic: xenophobe – xeno=stranger, phobia foreigners se darta hai

xenotransplantation.ex: Xenotransplantation may one day solve organ shortages.
xenotransplantation.mnemonic: xenotransplantation – xeno=alien, alien organ ko human me transplant
